The selected primary activity approach is accepted separately from full-scene comparison.

District fidelity pass, 0446b77 (range 332ae423..346f7986): Only the shared shop-sign helper gained an optional business list for other scenes; no intended visual change to Pike Place in the pass. The scene had changed between dc93023f and the pass (walking levels at the old camera points differ), which these views now show.

Fidelity pass round 2, 9824fd5 (range 94a177d5..9824fd56): North Arcade under a low shed roof, Victor Steinbrueck Park level on the bluff with its two poles, three-globe lamp posts on 1st Ave, an open 1st Ave corner; the city context is batched and culled per cell (frame budget).
remainingGaps: Fresh ground correction is scoped: the complete Gum Wall approach still stops before its final route goal; generic market facades/canopy supports and current Seattle context remain open.
Whole-market frontage/artwork accuracy and full fish trajectory framing remain open
Complete matched independent scene, entry and architectural/reference comparison remains open; source membership and cache hits are not visual parity.
Route/controller proof does not certify every secondary activity, completed-save persistence or full phone-thumbstick coverage.
